tool.name: ChronAeon Triage
tool.description: Streaming high-throughput QC and molecular clock outlier triage
tool.command: ln -s '$input_file' input.$input_file.extension && chronaeon triage --alignment input.$input_file.extension #if $dates_file: --dates '$dates_file' ## data_column params store a 1-based column INDEX, but the ## chronaeon CLI expects a column NAME. Resolve index -> name. #if $date_col: --date-col "\$(head -n1 '$dates_file' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$date_col)" #end if #if $strain_col: --strain-col "\$(head -n1 '$dates_file' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$strain_col)" #end if #end if #if $stream: --stream '$stream' #end if #if $stream_dates: --stream-dates '$stream_dates' #end if --n-anchor $n_anchor --n-bins $n_bins #if $root_taxon: --root-taxon '$root_taxon' #end if --tolerance-days $tolerance_days --z-threshold $z_threshold --max-ambig $max_ambig --output '$triage_output' #if $clean_out: --clean-out '$clean_output' #end if #if $sus_out: --sus-out '$sus_output' #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Reference / anchor alignment
param.help: Path to reference FASTA or anchor alignment

param.name: dates_file
param.label: Reference metadata (optional)
param.help: CSV/TSV containing collection dates for reference taxa

param.label: Streaming sequences (optional)
param.help: Incoming FASTA file of sequences to screen

param.label: Streaming metadata (optional)
param.help: Metadata CSV/TSV for streaming sequences (auto-extracted from FASTA if omitted)

param.label: Date column
param.help: Column for sample collection date (applies to reference metadata; the same column name is used for streaming metadata)

param.label: Strain column
param.help: Column for taxon / strain identifier (applies to reference metadata; the same column name is used for streaming metadata)

param.label: Number of anchor taxa
param.help: Number of anchor taxa for reference skeleton

param.label: Number of temporal bins
param.help: Number of temporal bins for stratified sampling

param.label: Root taxon (optional)
param.help: Reference taxon to use as ancestral root

param.label: Tolerance (days)
param.help: Maximum tolerated temporal error before flagging

param.label: Max ambiguity
param.help: Maximum fraction of ambiguous/missing bases (Ns) before flagging as SUS_LOW_QUALITY

param.name: clean_out
param.label: Export clean FASTA
param.help: Write filtered PASS sequences to an output file

param.name: sus_out
param.label: Export quarantined FASTA
param.help: Write SUS sequences to an output file

tool.help:
ChronAeon Triage: Streaming QC & Molecular Clock Outlier Detection ====================================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
Which incoming sequences are consistent with the established molecular clock skeleton, and which are outliers (too divergent, low quality, or temporally inconsistent)?
**How it works**
ChronAeon Triage builds a reference skeleton from anchor taxa, then screens streaming sequences against it. Sequences are classified as PASS or SUS (suspicious) based on temporal error, studentized residual divergence, and ambiguity fraction.
**Inputs**
- A reference FASTA alignment (anchor cohort) - Optional metadata with collection dates - Optional streaming FASTA of sequences to screen - Optional streaming metadata
**Outputs**
- **Triage report (CSV)**: per-sequence classification (PASS/SUS) with metrics - **Clean FASTA (optional)**: filtered PASS sequences only - **Quarantined FASTA (optional)**: SUS sequences flagged for review
